subject.title: feat(models): add provider request.timeoutMs and retry configuration

question: Should this PR expose `models.providers.*.retry` now, or split retry out until the canonical configurable LLM retry/backoff contract is settled?
rationale: The retry surface is public config that affects provider routing, fallback timing, and availability behavior, so the permanent API shape needs maintainer intent before merge.

options.title: Split Retry Out
options.body: Remove retry schema/help/label/type additions here and keep this PR focused on a proven `request.timeoutMs` change.

options.title: Implement Full Retry Contract
options.body: Wire retry into model calls with transient classification, fallback ordering, docs/baseline updates, and runtime tests before exposing the field.

options.title: Pause Behind Canonical Design
options.body: Hold or close this PR until the open retry tracker has a maintainer-approved public contract.

recommendation.title: Split Retry Out
recommendation.body: Remove retry schema/help/label/type additions here and keep this PR focused on a proven `request.timeoutMs` change.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc is the strongest visible routing candidate for the retry/failover product/API decision among the current provider and runner history candidates.
